title: Danger
shot: medium close-up, then wide with deep focus
camera: locked on KAIRO, rack focus to the bushes behind him
action: KAIRO freezes in the grass and turns his head. A large mysterious predator silhouette slides behind the bushes. Only a shape and the sound of it are visible.
lighting: sun a little higher, bushes in deep shade
audio: breath held, low drone, a heavy body brushing through leaves
dialogue_fa: یه صدایی از پشت سرم اومد... اول فکر کردم باد بوده. ولی نه... یه چیزی اونجا بود.
gloss_en: I heard a sound behind me... at first I thought it was the wind. But no... something was there.
continuity: predator silhouette only, no detail reveal before S10
transition: the silhouette pushes through the leaves, motivating S10
image_prompt: Medium close-up of KAIRO the stickman frozen in tall golden grass, head half turned, eyes wide, animal-hide tunic, spear gripped tight. Behind him, out of focus, a huge dark predator silhouette slides behind a dense wall of bushes. Sunrise backlight, dust and haze. 2D cinematic animation, suspense composition.
video_prompt: Camera locked on KAIRO. He freezes mid-step, head turning first, body following. Focus racks from his face to the bushes behind him where a large dark shape moves slowly, pushing leaves aside. Only silhouette and shadow, no detail. Grass trembles.
